fullText.simplified:
第三十三章、向着星光出发

    大家来到一个刻有“河洛村”的石碑处，仔细观察，下面的玄武背上确实有些圆点，还有一部分图案被立在龟背上的石碑挡住了。石碑和龟背的连接处，有一条裂痕。王长林和石文谦戴上手套，拿出专业的工具，开始对石碑和龟背进行拆解。十分钟后，他们看到了龟背上的完整图案，和王长林说的几乎一模一样。靠近龟头的第一排的数字是4，9和2；中间一排的数字是3，5和7；靠近龟尾的数字8，1和6。果然，横、竖、斜三条线上的三个数字，不管怎么相加都是15。
    15是什么？代表15分钟吗？从这里出发走15分钟？西汉时期应该还没有分钟的概念。代表距离吗？15公里？西汉时期的距离单位也还没有“公里”的说法。最大的可能性是“里”，从“河洛村”石碑处出发，沿着春分时期南柳星的方位，走15里，就能找到传说中的宝藏！
    扎格布尔、王长林、石文谦和简西商量了一下，决定立刻向这个地方出发。出发前，王长林联系了国家文物局和公安部，希望他们可以派人赶到现场。王长林又带上了研究组的工作人员，扎格布尔也带上了几个族人。大家各自收拾好东西，一起去往寻宝的路上。这一次他们能真实地感受到，离传说中的宝藏真的越来越近了……
    三辆车开往漫天黄沙的无人区。天色慢慢地转黑，天空星斗清晰可见。简西一边开车，一边根据南柳星辨别着方位。石文谦跟王长林补充了一些宝藏的背景信息。扎格布尔在叮嘱大家，出了河洛村，日夜温差会特别大，一会儿一定要把准备好的衣服都穿上。所有人都很严肃，这种严肃中又带着一些紧张，还有一些期待。
    这宝藏的神秘面纱马上就要被揭开了吗？会遇到什么危险吗？还有江杨和他的人，他们在哪儿？
fullText.traditional:
第三十三章、向著星光出發

    大家來到一個刻有“河洛村”的石碑處，仔細觀察，下面的玄武背上確實有些圓點，還有一部分圖案被立在龜背上的石碑擋住了。石碑和龜背的連接處，有一條裂痕。王長林和石文謙戴上手套，拿出專業的工具，開始對石碑和龜背進行拆解。十分鐘後，他們看到了龜背上的完整圖案，和王長林說的幾乎一模一樣。靠近龜頭的第一排的數字是4，9和2；中間一排的數字是3，5和7；靠近龜尾的數字8，1和6。果然，橫、豎、斜三條線上的三個數字，不管怎麼相加都是15。
    15是什麼？代表15分鐘嗎？從這裡出發走15分鐘？西漢時期應該還沒有分鐘的概念。代表距離嗎？15公里？西漢時期的距離單位也還沒有“公里”的說法。最大的可能性是“里”，從“河洛村”石碑處出發，沿著春分時期南柳星的方位，走15里，就能找到傳說中的寶藏！
    札格布爾、王長林、石文謙和簡西商量了一下，決定立刻向這個地方出發。出發前，王長林聯繫了國家文物局和公安部，希望他們可以派人趕到現場。王長林又帶上了研究組的工作人員，札格布爾也帶上了幾個族人。大家各自收拾好東西，一起去往尋寶的路上。這一次他們能真實地感受到，離傳說中的寶藏真的越來越近了……
    三輛車開往漫天黃沙的無人區。天色慢慢地轉黑，天空星斗清晰可見。簡西一邊開車，一邊根據南柳星辨別著方位。石文謙跟王長林補充了一些寶藏的背景信息。札格布爾在叮囑大家，出了河洛村，日夜溫差會特別大，一會兒一定要把準備好的衣服都穿上。所有人都很嚴肅，這種嚴肅中又帶著一些緊張，還有一些期待。
    這寶藏的神秘面紗馬上就要被揭開了嗎？會遇到什麼危險嗎？還有江楊和他的人，他們在哪兒？

sentences.simplified: 大家来到一个刻有“河洛村”的石碑处，
sentences.traditional: 大家來到一個刻有“河洛村”的石碑處，
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā lái dào yí ge kè yǒu hé luò cūn de shí bēi chù
sentences.english: They arrived at a stone tablet inscribed with “Heluo Village”.

sentences.simplified: 仔细观察，下面的玄武背上确实有些圆点，
sentences.traditional: 仔細觀察，下面的玄武背上確實有些圓點，
sentences.pinyin: zǐ xì guān chá xià miàn de xuán wǔ bèi shang què shí yǒu xiē yuán diǎn
sentences.english: Upon careful observation, there were indeed some round dots on the back of the Black Tortoise below.

sentences.simplified: 还有一部分图案被立在龟背上的石碑挡住了。
sentences.traditional: 還有一部分圖案被立在龜背上的石碑擋住了。
sentences.pinyin: hái yǒu yí bù fen tú àn bèi lì zài guī bèi shang de shí bēi dǎng zhù le
sentences.english: Part of the pattern was also blocked by the stone tablet that sat upright on the back of the tortoise.

sentences.simplified: 石碑和龟背的连接处，有一条裂痕。
sentences.traditional: 石碑和龜背的連接處，有一條裂痕。
sentences.pinyin: shí bēi hé guī bèi de lián jiē chù yǒu yì tiáo liè hén
sentences.english: At the connection between the stone tablet and the back of the tortoise, there was a crack.

sentences.simplified: 王长林和石文谦戴上手套，拿出专业的工具，
sentences.traditional: 王長林和石文謙戴上手套，拿出專業的工具，
sentences.pinyin: wáng cháng lín hé shí wén qiān dài shàng shǒu tào ná chū zhuān yè de gōng jù
sentences.english: Wang Changlin and Shi Wenqian put on gloves and took out professional tools.

sentences.simplified: 开始对石碑和龟背进行拆解。
sentences.traditional: 開始對石碑和龜背進行拆解。
sentences.pinyin: kāi shǐ duì shí bēi hé guī bèi jìn xíng chāi jiě
sentences.english: They began to disassemble the stone tablet and the tortoise shell.

sentences.simplified: 十分钟后，他们看到了龟背上的完整图案，
sentences.traditional: 十分鐘後，他們看到了龜背上的完整圖案，
sentences.pinyin: shí fēn zhōng hòu tā men kàn dào le guī bèi shang de wán zhěng tú àn
sentences.english: Ten minutes later, they saw the complete pattern on the back of the tortoise.

sentences.simplified: 和王长林说的几乎一模一样。
sentences.traditional: 和王長林說的幾乎一模一樣。
sentences.pinyin: hé wáng cháng lín shuō de jī hū yì mú yí yàng
sentences.english: It was almost identical to what Wang Changlin had described.

sentences.simplified: 靠近龟头的第一排的数字是4，9和2；
sentences.traditional: 靠近龜頭的第一排的數字是4，9和2；
sentences.pinyin: kào jìn guī tóu de dì yī pái de shù zì shì 1 1 hé 1
sentences.english: The numbers in the first row near the head of the tortoise were 4, 9, and 2.

sentences.simplified: 中间一排的数字是3，5和7；靠近龟尾的数字8，1和6。
sentences.traditional: 中間一排的數字是3，5和7；靠近龜尾的數字8，1和6。
sentences.pinyin: zhōng jiān yì pái de shù zì shì 1 1 hé 1 kào jìn guī wěi de shù zì 1 1 hé 1
sentences.english: The numbers in the middle row were 3, 5, and 7. The numbers near the tail of the tortoise were 8, 1, and 6.

sentences.simplified: 果然，横、竖、斜三条线上的三个数字，不管怎么相加都是15。
sentences.traditional: 果然，橫、豎、斜三條線上的三個數字，不管怎麼相加都是15。
sentences.pinyin: guǒ rán héng shù xié sān tiáo xiàn shang de sān ge shù zì bù guǎn zěn me xiāng jiā dōu shì 2
sentences.english: Indeed, the three numbers on the horizontal, vertical, and diagonal lines, no matter how they were added, always equaled 15.

sentences.simplified: 15是什么？代表15分钟吗？
sentences.traditional: 15是什麼？代表15分鐘嗎？
sentences.pinyin: 2 shì shén me dài biǎo 2 fēn zhōng ma
sentences.english: What was 15? Did it represent 15 minutes?

sentences.simplified: 从这里出发走15分钟？西汉时期应该还没有分钟的概念。
sentences.traditional: 從這裡出發走15分鐘？西漢時期應該還沒有分鐘的概念。
sentences.pinyin: cóng zhè lǐ chū fā zǒu 2 fēn zhōng xī hàn shí qī yīng gāi hái méi yǒu fēn zhōng de gài niàn
sentences.english: A 15-minute walk from here? The concept of minutes probably did not exist during the Western Han Dynasty.

sentences.simplified: 代表距离吗？15公里？
sentences.traditional: 代表距離嗎？15公里？
sentences.pinyin: dài biǎo jù lí ma 2 gōng lǐ
sentences.english: Did it represent distance? Fifteen kilometers?

sentences.simplified: 西汉时期的距离单位也还没有“公里”的说法。
sentences.traditional: 西漢時期的距離單位也還沒有“公里”的說法。
sentences.pinyin: xī hàn shí qī de jù lí dān wèi yě hái méi yǒu gōng lǐ de shuō fa
sentences.english: The concept of “kilometers” also did not yet exist as a unit of distance during the Western Han Dynasty.

sentences.simplified: 最大的可能性是“里”，
sentences.traditional: 最大的可能性是“里”，
sentences.pinyin: zuì dà de kě néng xìng shì lǐ
sentences.english: The greatest possibility was “li”.

sentences.simplified: 从“河洛村”石碑处出发，
sentences.traditional: 從“河洛村”石碑處出發，
sentences.pinyin: cóng hé luò cūn shí bēi chù chū fā
sentences.english: Starting from the “Heluo Village” stone tablet, ..

sentences.simplified: 沿着春分时期南柳星的方位，走15里，
sentences.traditional: 沿著春分時期南柳星的方位，走15里，
sentences.pinyin: yán zhe chūn fēn shí qī nán liǔ xīng de fāng wèi zǒu 2 lǐ
sentences.english: .. follow the direction of the Southern Willow Mansion during the spring equinox and walk 15 li, ..

sentences.simplified: 就能找到传说中的宝藏！
sentences.traditional: 就能找到傳說中的寶藏！
sentences.pinyin: jiù néng zhǎo dào chuán shuō zhōng de bǎo zàng
sentences.english: .. and you will be able to find the legendary treasure!

sentences.simplified: 扎格布尔、王长林、石文谦和简西商量了一下，决定立刻向这个地方出发。
sentences.traditional: 札格布爾、王長林、石文謙和簡西商量了一下，決定立刻向這個地方出發。
sentences.pinyin: zhā gé bù ěr wáng cháng lín shí wén qiān hé jiǎn xī shāng liang le yí xià jué dìng lì kè xiàng zhè ge dì fang chū fā
sentences.english: Zhage Bu’er, Wang Changlin, Shi Wenqian, and Jian Xi consulted and decided to set off for this place immediately.

sentences.simplified: 出发前，王长林联系了国家文物局和公安部，
sentences.traditional: 出發前，王長林聯繫了國家文物局和公安部，
sentences.pinyin: chū fā qián wáng cháng lín lián xì le guó jiā wén wù jú hé gōng ān bù
sentences.english: Before setting off, Wang Changlin contacted the National Cultural Heritage Administration and the Ministry of Public Security, ..

sentences.simplified: 希望他们可以派人赶到现场。
sentences.traditional: 希望他們可以派人趕到現場。
sentences.pinyin: xī wàng tā men kě yǐ pài rén gǎn dào xiàn chǎng
sentences.english: .. hoping that they could send people to the scene.

sentences.simplified: 王长林又带上了研究组的工作人员，扎格布尔也带上了几个族人。
sentences.traditional: 王長林又帶上了研究組的工作人員，札格布爾也帶上了幾個族人。
sentences.pinyin: wáng cháng lín yòu dài shàng le yán jiū zǔ de gōng zuò rén yuán zhā gé bù ěr yě dài shàng le jǐ ge zú rén
sentences.english: Wang Changlin also brought along the research group staff, and Zhage Bu’er also brought along a few of his people.

sentences.simplified: 大家各自收拾好东西，一起去往寻宝的路上。
sentences.traditional: 大家各自收拾好東西，一起去往尋寶的路上。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā gè zì shōu shi hǎo dōng xi yì qǐ qù wǎng xún bǎo de lù shang
sentences.english: Everyone packed up their things and set off to hunt for the treasure together.

sentences.simplified: 这一次他们能真实地感受到，离传说中的宝藏真的越来越近了……
sentences.traditional: 這一次他們能真實地感受到，離傳說中的寶藏真的越來越近了……
sentences.pinyin: zhè yí cì tā men néng zhēn shí de gǎn shòu dào lí chuán shuō zhōng de bǎo zàng zhēn de yuè lái yuè jìn le
sentences.english: This time, they could really feel that they were getting closer and closer to the legendary treasure …

sentences.simplified: 三辆车开往漫天黄沙的无人区。
sentences.traditional: 三輛車開往漫天黃沙的無人區。
sentences.pinyin: sān liàng chē kāi wǎng màn tiān huáng shā de wú rén qū
sentences.english: Three cars headed toward the uninhabited area, where the sky was filled with yellow sand.

sentences.simplified: 天色慢慢地转黑，天空星斗清晰可见。
sentences.traditional: 天色慢慢地轉黑，天空星斗清晰可見。
sentences.pinyin: tiān sè màn man de zhuǎn hēi tiān kōng xīng dǒu qīng xī kě jiàn
sentences.english: The sky gradually darkened, and the stars in the sky were clearly visible.

sentences.simplified: 简西一边开车，一边根据南柳星辨别着方位。
sentences.traditional: 簡西一邊開車，一邊根據南柳星辨別著方位。
sentences.pinyin: jiǎn xī yì biān kāi chē yì biān gēn jù nán liǔ xīng biàn bié zhe fāng wèi
sentences.english: While Jian Xi was driving, she determined directions based on the Southern Willow Mansion.

sentences.simplified: 石文谦跟王长林补充了一些宝藏的背景信息。
sentences.traditional: 石文謙跟王長林補充了一些寶藏的背景信息。
sentences.pinyin: shí wén qiān gēn wáng cháng lín bǔ chōng le yì xiē bǎo zàng de bèi jǐng xìn xī
sentences.english: Shi Wenqian and Wang Changlin added some background information about the hidden treasure.

sentences.simplified: 扎格布尔在叮嘱大家，出了河洛村，
sentences.traditional: 札格布爾在叮囑大家，出了河洛村，
sentences.pinyin: zhā gé bù ěr zài dīng zhǔ dà jiā chū le hé luò cūn
sentences.english: Zhage Bu’er was reminding everyone that once they left Heluo Village, ..

sentences.simplified: 日夜温差会特别大，
sentences.traditional: 日夜溫差會特別大，
sentences.pinyin: rì yè wēn chā huì tè bié dà
sentences.english: .. the temperature difference between day and night would be particularly large, ..

sentences.simplified: 一会儿一定要把准备好的衣服都穿上。
sentences.traditional: 一會兒一定要把準備好的衣服都穿上。
sentences.pinyin: yí huì'r yí dìng yào bǎ zhǔn bèi hǎo de yī fu dōu chuān shàng
sentences.english: .. and that in a while, everyone must put on all the clothes they had prepared.

sentences.simplified: 所有人都很严肃，这种严肃中又带着一些紧张，还有一些期待。
sentences.traditional: 所有人都很嚴肅，這種嚴肅中又帶著一些緊張，還有一些期待。
sentences.pinyin: suǒ yǒu rén dōu hěn yán sù zhè zhǒng yán sù zhōng yòu dài zhe yì xiē jǐn zhāng hái yǒu yì xiē qī dài
sentences.english: Everyone was very serious. This seriousness was mixed with some tension and also some anticipation.

sentences.simplified: 这宝藏的神秘面纱马上就要被揭开了吗？
sentences.traditional: 這寶藏的神秘面紗馬上就要被揭開了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: zhè bǎo zàng de shén mì miàn shā mǎ shàng jiù yào bèi jiē kāi le ma
sentences.english: Was the mysterious veil of this hidden treasure about to be lifted soon?

sentences.simplified: 会遇到什么危险吗？还有江杨和他的人，他们在哪儿？
sentences.traditional: 會遇到什麼危險嗎？還有江楊和他的人，他們在哪兒？
sentences.pinyin: huì yù dào shén me wēi xiǎn ma hái yǒu jiāng yáng hé tā de rén tā men zài nǎ'r
sentences.english: Would there be any danger? Also, where were Jiang Yang and his people?

sentence_translations: Chapter 33: Setting Off Toward the Starlight
They arrived at a stone tablet inscribed with “Heluo Village”.
Upon careful observation, there were indeed some round dots on the back of the Black Tortoise below.
Part of the pattern was also blocked by the stone tablet that sat upright on the back of the tortoise.
At the connection between the stone tablet and the back of the tortoise, there was a crack.
Wang Changlin and Shi Wenqian put on gloves and took out professional tools.
They began to disassemble the stone tablet and the tortoise shell.
Ten minutes later, they saw the complete pattern on the back of the tortoise.
It was almost identical to what Wang Changlin had described.
The numbers in the first row near the head of the tortoise were 4, 9, and 2.
The numbers in the middle row were 3, 5, and 7. The numbers near the tail of the tortoise were 8, 1, and 6.
Indeed, the three numbers on the horizontal, vertical, and diagonal lines, no matter how they were added, always equaled 15.
What was 15? Did it represent 15 minutes?
A 15-minute walk from here? The concept of minutes probably did not exist during the Western Han Dynasty.
Did it represent distance? Fifteen kilometers?
The concept of “kilometers” also did not yet exist as a unit of distance during the Western Han Dynasty.
The greatest possibility was “li”.
Starting from the “Heluo Village” stone tablet, ..
.. follow the direction of the Southern Willow Mansion during the spring equinox and walk 15 li, ..
.. and you will be able to find the legendary treasure!
Zhage Bu’er, Wang Changlin, Shi Wenqian, and Jian Xi consulted and decided to set off for this place immediately.
Before setting off, Wang Changlin contacted the National Cultural Heritage Administration and the Ministry of Public Security, ..
.. hoping that they could send people to the scene.
Wang Changlin also brought along the research group staff, and Zhage Bu’er also brought along a few of his people.
Everyone packed up their things and set off to hunt for the treasure together.
This time, they could really feel that they were getting closer and closer to the legendary treasure …
Three cars headed toward the uninhabited area, where the sky was filled with yellow sand.
The sky gradually darkened, and the stars in the sky were clearly visible.
While Jian Xi was driving, she determined directions based on the Southern Willow Mansion.
Shi Wenqian and Wang Changlin added some background information about the hidden treasure.
Zhage Bu’er was reminding everyone that once they left Heluo Village, ..
.. the temperature difference between day and night would be particularly large, ..
.. and that in a while, everyone must put on all the clothes they had prepared.
Everyone was very serious. This seriousness was mixed with some tension and also some anticipation.
Was the mysterious veil of this hidden treasure about to be lifted soon?
Would there be any danger? Also, where were Jiang Yang and his people?
